findings.message: HI bhāvārtha says 'वे सबके आदि कारण हैं' ('the first cause of all'). No pada says 'सबके' (of all): ādikāraṇam is only 'a primary cause' (mw-adikarana.md, MW p. 137,1). The line segment ('जो आदि कारण हैं') and the EN bhāvārtha ('He is the first cause') both leave it out. It is a small addition and a reasonable thing to infer, so a human should decide whether to keep it.
